description: Takes a picture of a person and an audio file and generates a video of THAT person speaking or singing the audio, lip-synced. Returns the new job's id immediately; the result is exactly as long as the audio. WHEN: the user wants a talking avatar, a presenter or a voiceover on a face. The picture supplies the person; the audio supplies the performance AND the length. The whole flow: `get_recipe` `talking-avatar`. CONSENT: only a picture of the user, of someone who gave their permission, or of a fictional or AI-generated character; never a real person without their permission, and never a public figure or celebrity (decline and offer a generated character). THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card with the result: say one line, never its `url` (no card? give it); no `show_generation`. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), never timers or background shells. COST: this spends the user's tokens: the AUDIO's length times a per-second rate that depends on resolution. The server measures the audio's length, rounded UP to the next whole second: that measurement is the price. An external url costs one media-ingest slot: quote and create from the SAME url to pay it once. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_cost`, state it (or its job's total) in the same message as your ask, call at its price inside that go (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).

character_image.description: URL of the picture of the person who should speak (a clear, front-facing portrait works best; see CONSENT). A URL from this account's generations or uploads, or a public https URL (imported first); another account's is refused.

input_seconds.description: Seconds of audio to price in place of `source_audio`, for audio not made yet; with `estimate_only` only.

max_tokens.description: The quote's `estimated_tokens`; above it the create is refused, not charged.

prompt.description: Optional direction for the performance (a mood or manner). It does not change what is said: the words come from the audio.

resolution.description: Output resolution; 1080p costs exactly twice 720p per second of audio. REQUIRED: use `720p` unless the user asked for `1080p`, and name the choice in the priced ask; never carried over from an earlier request.

source_audio.description: The audio to lip-sync to. An audio generation on this account (its id or url) or an MP3, WAV or M4A uploaded on it (`upload_media_widget` or `upload_media`). No external urls.

name: generate_lipsync
title: Make a picture of a person speak your audio
